stream: dataset / Lexibank / version-integrity and exact language-row locator verification
purpose: Move the Peiros Austroasiatic CLDF lead beyond discovery-only status by pinning a released version, DOI, immutable tag commit, CLDF file identities and the exact Mundari language-table locator while withholding lexical form rows until exact Mundari FormTable extraction and independent reconciliation are complete.

source.title: CLDF dataset derived from Peiros' Genetic classification of Austro-Asiatic languages from 2004

rights_and_cultural_boundary.note: The release-level CC BY 4.0 declaration supports reuse of the licensed derived dataset subject to attribution, but it is not treated as proof of participant consent, community validation, cultural-access permission, or independent licensing of every underlying historical source beyond the dataset's stated licence scope.

deduplication.reason_count_neutral: Peiros was already tracked as a dataset discovery/integrity blocker. This run strengthens that same work-family to a released-version and exact Mundari language-row audit; it does not prove equivalence to an unresolved WEB-MUN lead or add a new controlled identity.

promotion.level: released-version + DOI + commit/tree/blob integrity locators + exact Mundari LanguageTable row

explicit_gaps: Extract every FormTable row whose Language_ID is exactly Mundari from the pinned v1.1 forms.csv and reconcile row count against the declared 10,706-row table.
Independently verify extracted Mundari forms against the pinned blob and source-reference column before any lexical-row promotion.
Preserve attribution/source lineage from Peiros2004a and verify any underlying-source rights nuance required for redistribution of lexical derivatives.
Apply MLHKP cultural-access review before exposing any item later determined to carry culturally restricted or sensitive content.
